title: How To Overcome Your Fear
text: [Music] fear is wonderful now let me explain what i mean god will never give you anything to do that will not frighten you if what you are dreaming of doing doesn't make you afraid it is not from god god's dreams will always make you afraid because he wants to make sure that only he could make it possible in other words god wants the credit so if what you're doing doesn't need god to get it done it's not god's assignment for your life so the fear that you feel is proof that it is from god so when you are afraid that means go for it when you are afraid you start wherever you are with nothing i started with zero zero no one gave me anything i started with an idea and everything in life begins that way and if god's ideas are in your head they'll frighten you but that fear is what motivates you to believe it is from god so don't be afraid of your fear use it to give you courage courage is only possible where fear is present you cannot be courageous unless you are afraid so the fear gives birth to courage and the courage is motivated by faith and so if you want to be fearless you must have courage courage doesn't mean the absence of fear courage courage means to move in spite of fear fear is a sign that you have an assignment from god courage is the ability to do it in spite of the fear so don't be afraid of your fear use it to create courage you
